Chapter 19: General Services 
19.01 General Services 
a. Patent Office provides certain statutory and non- statutory services 
for the dissemination of information related to patent processing. 
b. It may be noted that references to some of these services have 
already been made in the relevant Chapters. 
c. These services are enumerated in the following para graphs as per 
standards set by the Patent Office. 

19.02 Official Journal 
 Every Friday the Controller publishes the Official Patent Journal 
electronically, which is made available on the official website of the 
Patent Office (www.ipindia.nic.in).
